stage1.impression: A red tinted-acrylic horn speaker centred on a dark seamless, with a soft glow behind it and a red reflection in the floor. The colour is strong and the silhouette reads, but the right side face and the top of the front are blown to white or pink slabs, the horn is an almost black blob with a drawn-looking white outline, and the inner blocks read as plastic. It is competent product CG, not yet a photograph.

blocking_9: The acrylic keeps its red on every face: no face with a near-white median (right side face g_median now 229, should be below 120)
The horn shows its form and its tint, with light passing through it, not a crushed black mass (horn median 11.6 with 26% crushed)
The speculars trace the edges as thin lines instead of flooding whole faces: the top band of the front is now clipped red, pink (r 251, g 129)
The floor reflection reads as a faint mirror image that fades out well before the frame edge, not a red smear running off the bottom
More negative space for type: the product now fills about 56% of the frame height

defects.what: The right side face is blown to near white (median 234, RGB 251/229/234), so the red acrylic reads as a white plastic slab
A broad sheen reflection washes the top band of the front face to clipped pink (r 251, g 129)
The horn body is crushed (median 11.6, 26% crushed). Its shape and tint are lost, and only a white outline remains, which looks like a rim shader
A hard white outline around the horn reads as a drawn halo (p95 234 against a body median of 12)
The left vertical edge clips (9% clipped) with a hard white line
The floor reflection is a soft red column that is still bright at the frame bottom (median 23, r 65), so it reads as a glow smear, not a reflection
The inner blocks and brackets in the base light up flat pink and read as plastic parts (product, out of scope)
The product is about 400 of 720 px tall, which leaves tight room for a headline above

changes.problem: strip-right floods the whole right side face with white specular, so the red is lost there.

evidence.measured: lum_median 234, RGB median 251/229/234, the colour of the lamp and not the acrylic

changes.expected: The right face goes back to deep red with one thin bright line on its rear vertical edge. The face's median green falls below about 110.

changes.problem: The sheen panel's reflection covers the upper front face and clips it to pink.
changes.expected: The top of the front becomes a saturated red with a gradient instead of a pink band, and the red channel stops clipping.

changes.problem: Nothing lights the horn from behind or through it, so its tinted acrylic is a black mass.

change.to: panel 0.7 x 0.35 m at [0.0, 0.9, 1.2], target [0.0, 0.0, 1.18], strength 10, diffuse 1.0, specular 0.0

changes.expected: Light passes through the horn's walls, so the horn glows a mid red with its throat and flare visible and the white outline no longer dominates.

evidence.measured: rim p95 234 against a body median of 12.6: a halo line with no body highlight

changes.expected: A soft graduated highlight runs along the horn's upper face and gives it volume. The share of crushed pixels on the horn drops below about 8%.

changes.problem: The floor reflection is a blurred red column that runs off the bottom of the frame instead of a faint mirror image that fades.

evidence.measured: lum_median 23.4, r_median 65 at the frame bottom, against 35.9 just below the base

changes.problem: strip-left draws a hard clipped line down the left edge.

changes.problem: The product fills about 56% of the frame height, which leaves little room for a headline in an Apple-style hero.

out_of_scope.request: Give the internal blocks and brackets in the base a less flat, plastic look
out_of_scope.why: They are parts of the speaker. Light changes c1 and c2 will reduce the flat pink fill, but their material and shape are fixed.
